2.2.0.title: Profiles, and invites that know who you are
notes: Your profile: add your name and a photo (tap your picture on the first screen). Your photo shows on you in every home and trip.
Invite one person at a time: each person gets their own link. Opening it joins as them, no more picking your name from a list.
Send an invite by email right from the app. Signing in with that address sets them up as the right person.
New phone? Sign in and the app already knows who you are in each group.
People in settings show who has joined, who is invited, and their email.

2.1.0.title: Personal spending, safer adding, a smarter to-buy list
notes: Personal tab: your own expenses, private to you. Your total includes your share of the home.
Check before saving: see the amount, who paid, each share and who owes whom before anything is added.
Amounts fill themselves in: type what some people owe or paid, the rest is shared equally.
To-buy list: tap “I'll buy” or assign someone, mark urgent or needed by a day. The buyer gets a reminder.
Updates bell and a dashboard: what others changed, what needs you, what you spent this month.
Reminders on your phone for bills, tonight's meals and things you're buying.
Tap any expense for its full split and history, or a person for their statement.
More filters in Activity. Bills, meals, list and settings are now under the grid icon at the top.
